text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PROD:EMBED-5XX spike (PD#12345) — urgency: high.
micah: acked. grabbing it now.
sana: oncall handoff — I'm on the bridge in 1m, pinging eng-oncall.
jordan: seeing 5xx jump from 0.4% -> ~12% starting 10:11 UTC, p95 latency 2.4s, error signature = upstream timeout.
micah: logs look like `kvcache timeout` and `read timeout from redis` for embedding-worker-*.
opsbot: created channel #inc-1787654320 for the bridge and attached runbook.
sana: quick customer-impact check — hosted API inference for embeddings seeing failed requests; likely affecting small subset of customers in us-west-2. @support please standby to notify if we confirm customer-facing errors.
support: standing by. will prepare template.
micah: metric snapshot: embed-requests 1.2k rps -> 1.4k rps, 5xx at ~150rps peak.
jordan: switching traffic away from pool A -> pool B (start).
micah: temporary mitigation: enabling failfast + small rate-limit on /v1/embeddings route on the edge to shed slow requests. applying now: `nginx rate_limit zone=embedburst 200r/s; proxy_next_upstream off;`
sana: applied patch, rolling at 10:18 UTC.
micah: immediate drop in 5xx to 8% at 10:19, continuing to trend down.
jordan: pool A nodes showing increased eviction events and high memory churn — possible kvcache eviction cascade. collecting vmstats.
micah: mitigation follow-up: restarting one problematic worker in pool A (recovery test).
opsbot: note: incident severity = sev2, assigned to micah (primary) + sana (liaison).
support: prepping customer emails: 3 customers flagged with >5% error rate, will send update once we confirm stabilization.
jordan: after reroute + failfast p95 latency back to 0.6s, 5xx down to ~1.1% at 10:26.
micah: continuing to monitor for 30m. opening postmortem ticket TKT-987 for root-cause analysis (kvcache eviction heuristics + dedicated pool handling).
sana: handoff to follow-up owners: eng-runtime (micah) + infra (jordan). I'll coordinate customer comms.
micah: marking page resolved in PagerDuty at 10:42 UTC after metrics stable for ~15m.
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert resolved -> PD#12345 closed.
sana: filing short blameless note in #postmortems and will add timeline + mitigation steps. :white_check_mark:
